subject: Implementation schedule, crediting cadence, and evidence delivery for compliance add-ons
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@healthnova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@procureco.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline and costs for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, residency)

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move toward procurement, the legal and security teams have three concrete asks so we can finalize the PO:

1) A clear implementation timeline (kickoff -> evidence delivery -> audit-ready state) for audit-log retention tiers, KMS vs HSM options, and cross-border residency (US vs EU).
2) How you propose credits/concessions for the implementation fees if we commit to a 12-month usage commit. Procurement prefers amortized credits but we can consider an upfront offset.
3) A sample of the "evidence package" we’ll receive (audit log export sample, HSM attestation template, SOC2-related artifacts) and the delivery cadence.

I've attached our procurement worksheet to capture price lines and billing terms (HealthNova_procurement_sheet.xlsx). Our target is to be audit-ready by end of Q3. Please include approximate lead times for HSM provisioning (if there’s a separate ordering process).

Cheers,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Cloud Security
HealthNova

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@healthnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timeline and costs for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, residency)

Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Below is a pragmatic proposal with pricing bands, implementation milestones, and evidence delivery cadence. Attaching a one-page summary (compliance-pricing-summary.pdf) for your procurement team.

Pricing (USD, list — we’ll apply your commit discounts below):
- Audit log retention tiers: 30d = $0.00 (base), 365d = $3,000/mo, 7yr (archival) = $6,000/mo
- KMS: per-key pool (managed KMS) = $800/mo per 25 keys; usage-based API calls included up to 100k calls/mo, $0.02 per 1k calls overage
- HSM (bring-your-key / FIPS-attested): one-time provisioning fee $45,000 + $3,200/mo per HSM cluster (includes attestation and quarterly reports)
- Data residency (EU region activation): single-region residency surcharge = $1,500/mo (in addition to model/throughput costs)

Crediting / Discounting approach:
- 12-month committed spend (>= $250k ARR): 10% on recurring add-ons; implementation fee credit equal to 50% of one-time implementation fee, amortized monthly over first 6 months.
- 24-month commit: 15% on recurring add-ons; full implementation fee credit amortized over 12 months.

Proposed implementation milestones (approx):
1) Contract & SOW signed (Week 0)
2) Kickoff & access provisioning (Week 1)
3) HSM procurement/provisioning (if chosen) — typically 4–8 weeks from order confirmation; parallel KMS onboarding (Week 2–4)
4) Audit-log ingestion pipeline and retention policy applied (Week 2–6)
5) Evidence package initial delivery (sample artifacts + attestation templates) — end of Week 6
6) Go-live & audit-readiness review (Week 8–12)

Evidence package contents and cadence:
- Initial artifact set (Week 6): sample audit log extracts (CSV + hashed index), HSM provisioning certificate, KMS key inventory export, system configuration snapshot, and access-control roster.
- Ongoing: monthly snapshot exports for 3 months post-go-live, quarterly attestation reports thereafter.
- SOC2-related artifacts: control descriptions, recent penetration-testing summary, and SOC2 report access (subject to NDA).

Open items I need from your side:
- Confirmation on commit length (12 vs 24 months) to lock in discount and crediting schedule.
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly invoice vs quarterly) and PO/payment terms target.

Ben/Marissa — tagging you for billing/legal alignment and to confirm if we can split the implementation offset across invoices (Vanessa proposes amortization as above).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@healthnova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timeline and costs for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, residency)

Vanessa — looks good. A few procurement/finance clarifications before we send a formal quote:

1) Implementation fee treatment: finance prefers to amortize the credit across the first 3 invoices (monthly) for 12-month deals; for 24-month deals we can extend amortization to the first 6 invoices. That maps better to our revenue recognition.
2) Net payment terms: Olivia mentioned 60 days in the call — confirm whether HealthNova can do Net 60. If they need Net 30, discount comps will differ.
3) HSM provisioning lead time: from ops — 6 weeks average; for an accelerated path there is an expedited one-time handling fee of $6,500.
4) Legal/Contract: need Exhibit A listing evidence deliverables and SLAs. Also note: indemnity and data-processing addenda (DPA) will be standard. I'll draft a procurement-friendly summary for Marissa to attach to the commercial proposal.

If Olivia confirms commit and terms, I can produce a commercial appendix (line-itemized) and an invoice schedule that matches the amortization plan.

—Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@healthnova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@procureco.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Timeline and costs for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, residency)

Thanks — this is helpful and gives us what procurement needs to prepare the PO. A few confirmations from our side: 

- HealthNova is willing to commit 12 months at the $250k ARR threshold to secure the 10% recurring add-on discount and 50% implementation credit (amortized).
- Net 60 is acceptable.
- We would like the HSM path, but please include the expedited provisioning option (we may need it for an earlier audit).
- Please provide the Exhibit A evidence checklist and the sample artifacts referenced (sample audit log extract, HSM provisioning certificate, and the KMS key inventory export). Rajesh: can you confirm if procureco requires any additional fields on the PO?

Next steps for Redwood: please send a line-item commercial appendix formatted for procurement (we prefer an invoice schedule column) and a DocuSign link when the contract is ready. I attached our PO template (PO_template_HealthNova.docx) for your legal team to review formatting.

Once we get the DocuSign link and the commercial appendix, procurement will issue a PO within two weeks.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Cloud Security
HealthNova
